ReleaseNotes:
EEFlasher Release Notes — Version 1.0.72

This release introduces interface alignment improvements, status-aware progress indicators, and an enhanced dual-file verification workflow in Firmware Tools.

Changelog & Updates

Operation Status & Progress Bar

Integrated dynamic color states on the main progress bar based on active hardware operations:
Red: Erasing
Green: Writing / Programming
Blue: Verifying
Orange: Reading, Blank Check, and Unlock routines
Adjusted status bar geometry to align directly with the sidebar border and hex editor origin.
Firmware Tools — Dual Checksum & Hash Verification

Redesigned the Checksums & Hashes module into a side-by-side dual binary comparison layout (File 1 / Original vs File 2 / Comparison).
Added row-by-row match validation (MATCH / DIFF) across MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, CRC-32, and 8/16/32-bit checksums with overall identity status detection.
Added support for loading directly from active hex editor buffers, one-click file slot swapping, and full comparison report export.
Upgraded the instant hash verifier to evaluate input values against both binary targets simultaneously.
UI Safety & Controls

Activity log toolbar buttons (Copy Log, Diagnostic Bug Report, Clear Log) and associated context menu entries are now locked and disabled while any flash operation is active.
Removed redundant hash badges from the activity log status strip for a cleaner interface.
